system.moveDescription: You can mark The Chromatic Desert whenever you want. The other Latchkeys don’t forget who you are when you have it marked, and you can continue interacting with them so long as there is a television nearby: you appear on whatever program is being watched and can hear people when they speak to you through the TV. When the Latchkeys watch an Odyssey tape, your Latchkey scenes can take place inside the Odyssey tape scenes.
